deviations: GradCAM++ requires second/third-order autograd through model layers. Hook-based activation capture breaks the computation graph for higher-order derivatives in PyTorch. 4 tests xfailed. A future fix would require model splitting or torch.autograd.functional API.
RISE uses 1000 masks (approximate). Outputs labeled with approximate=True. Use 4000+ for published results.
Insertion/deletion AUC uses 20 steps. Full evaluation should use 30+ steps.
GradCAM++ skipped in smoke mode (is_smoke=True + skip_smoke=True); runs on pilot when is_smoke=False.
